candidate_formula_or_rule: Use decoded monster fields as entity inputs: level, HP, armor_class, damage_resistance, magic_resistance, base_experience, attacks, spells.
supporting_evidence: Imported codex-monster-wcc has 1100 records with direct columns; RuntimePrep0007 previously organized monster HP/level/damage/XP/gold expected fields.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No observed live attack rolls, timing, targeting, or hit/miss outcomes.
simulator_impact: Safe to expose fields in simulator data model; do not certify live resolution.

candidate_formula_or_rule: For weapons/items, min_hit and max_hit are candidate raw damage bounds; monster attacks array supplies attack rows when present.
supporting_evidence: 1950 imported item records include min_hit/max_hit; 1100 monster records include attacks field; simulator Build0019 confirmed slot identity across items.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No live rolls observed; no proof of stat bonuses, skill bonuses, or mitigation order.
simulator_impact: Use as expected-model damage input only.

candidate_formula_or_rule: armor_class, damage_resistance, magic_resistance, item ac_bonus, and dr_bonus are additive candidate inputs to defense/mitigation.
supporting_evidence: Imported item and monster records provide AC/DR/MR columns; 565 item records have nonzero AC/DR.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No supported equation converting AC/DR/MR to hit chance or final damage.
simulator_impact: Model fields but keep roll formula runtime_required.

supporting_evidence: backstab_defense exists on monsters; item accuracy and speed fields exist; class weapon_bonus/combat_bonus exist.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No repeated static table pattern can prove a random roll, dodge threshold, crit chance, or backstab algorithm.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Race exp_modifier and class exp_modifier are decoded static modifiers. Candidate combined multiplier may use both, but combination order is not proven.
supporting_evidence: 13 race records and 15 class records contain exp_modifier fields.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No level-up observations or original runtime XP award trace.
simulator_impact: Expose modifiers; mark combined progression formula runtime_required.

candidate_formula_or_rule: base_experience and experience_multiplier are decoded reward inputs.
supporting_evidence: 1100 imported monster records include base_experience and experience_multiplier.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Party split, level penalties, bonuses, and exact multiplier application are not observed.

candidate_formula_or_rule: No certified XP-to-level table found in decoded direct records in this pass.
supporting_evidence: Class/race modifiers exist; monsters have XP values.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No authoritative threshold table or live level-up events in inputs analyzed.
simulator_impact: Do not update simulator thresholds as original behavior.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Use item item_type/properties.worn_on plus class_restrictions, race_restrictions, stat_requirements as decoded equipment constraints.
supporting_evidence: 1950 imported item records; Build0019 tested 1770 repo equipment rows and 625 equippable evidence-slot items.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Live equip acceptance, two-hand/offhand, durability, encumbrance, and special scripts not observed.
simulator_impact: Safe to enrich simulator expected model with decoded restriction fields.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Statistical candidate: numeric item bonuses are additive unless item-specific ability/script says otherwise.
supporting_evidence: Items provide multiple independent bonus columns and abilities_named lists.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: No live equip/unequip deltas; special ability semantics unresolved.
simulator_impact: Do not certify stacking; optional expected-model additive projection only.

candidate_formula_or_rule: mana_cost, energy_cost, min_effect, max_effect, duration, attack_type, resist_type, difficulty, level caps/increase fields are decoded spell inputs.
supporting_evidence: 1350 imported spell records contain spell behavior columns; DataDecode0068/CodeUpdate notes preserve spell engine proof inventory.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Casting success, target validation, resist roll, effect tick cadence and stacking are unobserved.
simulator_impact: Add formula inputs; leave execution semantics runtime_required.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Candidate scaling uses levels_for_*_increase with min_increase/max_increase/duration_increase capped by level_cap.
supporting_evidence: Spell table has explicit levels_for_max/min/duration increase fields and nonzero counts in many records.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Exact caster-level variable and rounding/cap order are unobserved.
simulator_impact: Implement only as labeled candidate formula, disabled from original-certification mode.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Shop inventory item_id, max_qty, regen_qty, normal_qty, regen_time, regen_percent are decoded shop-stock inputs.
supporting_evidence: 178 shop records with 3550 inventory rows; shop records include room mapping and exits.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Whether regen_time units are ticks/minutes and runtime restock scheduling are unobserved.
simulator_impact: Safe expected-model shop stock projection with boundary note.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Candidate displayed price = item cost adjusted by shop markup_percent; currency type from item cost_type.
supporting_evidence: Shop markup_percent exists; imported item cost/cost_type exists for 1309 priced items; shops have markup distribution {'0': 50, '100': 44, '500': 24, '300': 17, '200': 9, '275': 9}.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Buy/sell spread, charisma, haggle, class restrictions, bank/repair/training costs are not observed.
simulator_impact: Use markup as candidate; leave exact transaction formula runtime_required.

candidate_formula_or_rule: Level correlates with HP/XP/AC/MR, but individual records are hand-authored; do not derive a universal formula.
supporting_evidence: Correlation matrix generated across 1100 monster records.
contradicting_or_missing_evidence: Wide outliers and hand-authored bosses/variants prevent a single formula.
simulator_impact: No formula update; use decoded per-record stats.
